source: Subscription plans, sales playbook and compliance checklists. Pricing structure taken from the published MyServicePro playbook (docs/pricing-packages.md, pitch-script.md, lead-list-template.md, permission-checklist.md, ai-image-workflow.md in github.com/Albert-Machuene-Dev/MyServicePro_Demos) and rebuilt so that every claim is enforceable: update allowances are metered by policy, permission records are hash-chained, and a month's fee is held in escrow until the site is actually live.
promise: Zero upfront build cost. We design, maintain and host. You just run your business — and every button on the site actually works.

positioning.strategy: Lead with Business Growth as the recommended option, use Essential as the entry point for price-sensitive owners, and use Enterprise as the anchor that makes Business Growth look affordable.
positioning.oneLiner: For less than the cost of one slow night, your website becomes your best salesperson.

plans.name: Essential Start
plans.audience: Small businesses that just need to be found and look credible
plans.blurb: One stunning mobile-first page, your catalogue online, hosting and SSL included, and two updates a month so it does not rot.
features: One-page mobile-first site from a ProVeri industry template
Live catalogue: menu, rooms, treatments, services or collection with prices
Hosting, SSL and daily backups included
Click-to-call, WhatsApp click-to-chat and a map link
Opening hours and contact block with LocalBusiness structured data
2 minor updates per month (menu changes, hours, photos)
Basic Google Search Console submission
plans.honestBoundary: Two updates a month means price and photo changes, not a redesign. If you change your menu weekly, Business Growth is the honest buy.
plans.proveriUpgrade: Free ProVeri trust block: verification checks and escrow-backed reviews pulled live from the audit ledger, so a visitor can check you instead of trusting you.
excludes: Booking automation beyond a request form

plans.name: Business Growth
plans.audience: Busy businesses ready to turn visitors into confirmed bookings
plans.blurb: Everything in Essential, plus live booking that creates real reservations or escrow-ready jobs, local SEO, and five updates a month.
features: Everything in Essential Start
Live booking form with industry-specific fields — reservations, transfer requests or escrow-protected trade jobs
Bookings land in the ProVeri business inbox with a reference number, and become jobs in the marketplace when the site is linked to a verified pro
Local SEO: Google Business Profile setup, review generation flow, LocalBusiness + Product schema
Photo gallery with permission-checked assets and a lightbox
Testimonials block, escrow-backed reviews where they exist
5 minor updates per month
Priority support — same business day on WhatsApp
Monthly performance report: views, bookings, and where visitors dropped off
plans.honestBoundary: We set up your Google Business Profile and give you the review flow. We cannot promise rankings, and we will not pretend to. What we can show you is bookings, with numbers.
plans.proveriUpgrade: A booking made on your site can open an escrow-protected ProVeri job — the customer's money is held, your payment is guaranteed before you start, and the review is written after release. No website platform in South Africa closes that loop.
excludes: Paid ad spend (managed separately as a growth service)

plans.name: Enterprise Power
plans.audience: Established businesses and multi-location groups that need backend power
plans.blurb: Everything in Business Growth, plus a customer database, online ordering or quoting, analytics, an assistant for booking enquiries, and unlimited updates.
features: Everything in Business Growth
Unlimited minor updates
Multi-location support: one brand, many addresses, each with its own hours and booking flow
Customer database (CRM) with booking history, consent state and notes
Online ordering or quoting with Paystack/Stripe checkout into escrow
Analytics dashboard: bookings, revenue held in escrow, conversion by page
Assistant for booking enquiries — answers FAQs on WhatsApp and hands a human anything it cannot resolve
Optional POS or accounting integration
Custom feature development quoted per item, in escrow, milestone by milestone
plans.honestBoundary: The booking assistant is a rules-and-retrieval bot, not a person. It is labelled as an assistant on every message and escalates to a human the moment a request falls outside what it can confirm.
plans.proveriUpgrade: Every checkout goes through the same escrow engine as a plumbing job: milestone releases, a 5% workmanship holdback, geotagged proof of work, and a dispute centre that weighs evidence rather than opinions.

planIncludesComparison.feature: Bookings become ProVeri jobs with escrow

permissions.source: MyServicePro_Demos/docs/permission-checklist.md — upgraded from a markdown checklist to a hash-chained record that gates publishing.
principles: Photos and videos are protected by copyright the moment they are created.
The business may not own the copyright to its own social media content — the photographer or creator might.
Giving credit is not a substitute for permission.
If identifiable people appear in an image, POPIA consent is required in addition to copyright permission.
If permission cannot be obtained, use a licensed stock photo or a clearly labelled AI-generated image instead.

checklist.label: Written permission from the owner or manager to use the content
Owner confirms they hold the copyright or have cleared it with the creator
Identifiable people in the images consented (POPIA)
The permission itself is stored — email, WhatsApp screenshot or signed note
Any AI-generated image is labelled as such on the public page
Any required credit line is recorded and shown

permissions.demoSafeDefault: Unlisted preview URLs are low risk and need no permission records. The moment a site is published to a public URL, every asset it uses must have a permission record — enforced by policy WEB-002, not by memory.

aiImages.labellingPolicy: An AI-generated image must carry aiGenerated=true and render a visible 'Image is illustrative' note on the public page. We do not let a generated steak stand in for a real one without saying so.
aiImages.promptTemplate: Professional {style} photography, {item}, {setting}, {lighting}, appetising and true to colour, 4K, photorealistic, no text, no watermark, no logos
